items.title: Pfizer (PFE) Q3 Earnings Rebuild Confidence As New Drugs Gain Ground
items.summary: Pfizer just put Q3 2026 on the table and the first instinctive verdict from traders was a modest nod, with the stock up about 2.6% to roughly $30.80 after the release. Headlines are all about a clean return to profitability, with basic earnings per share at $0.57 on revenue of $16.6b, and an adjusted earnings beat that quickly caught the eye. items.title: Missed Out On Pfizer's Run? Here Is What Holders Saw
items.summary: If Pfizer sat on your watchlist instead of in your portfolio, the past few months may feel like a missed call. Holding Pfizer from the start of the year would have returned 28.6%, including dividends. That outcome followed fresh oncology approvals, obesity data and a new China-focused cancer partnership that grabbed headlines late in the period. items.title: Moderna Soars 8% on Early Multiple Myeloma Data for Its Three-in-One mRNA Therapy
items.summary: Key TakeawaysModerna shares jumped 8% after its myeloma therapy, mRNA-2808, showed four confirmed responses among 11 heavily pretreated patients. The data shows Moderna’s mRNA can get the body to make three cancer drugs at once, though it’s years from challenging Johnson & Johnson, Pfizer and Regeneron.
